scripts.build: npm run prep && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:full: npm run prep && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never --config electron-builder-full.yml
scripts.build:win: npm run prep && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder-win.yml
scripts.build:win:full: npm run prep && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder-win-full.yml
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:full && npm run build:win && npm run build:win:full
